info.name: ZOOMX Digital API
info.description:
Complete backend API collection for ZOOMX Digital.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}} (default http://localhost:5005/api)

Auth: Most write endpoints require a Bearer token. Run **Auth > Login** first — it auto-saves the token to the {{token}} collection variable. Public endpoints are marked (Public).
